_comment: Master dictionary of words learned. One entry per headword. Entries with source='sample' are placeholder data shipped so the app is usable before the screenshots land - build_deck.py drops them as soon as real entries exist.

entries.english: by the way; while you're at it

example.simplified: 你去超市的时候，顺便帮我买点牛奶。
example.pinyin: Nǐ qù chāoshì de shíhou, shùnbiàn bāng wǒ mǎi diǎn niúnǎi.
example.english: When you go to the supermarket, grab me some milk while you're at it.

example.pinyin: Qíshí wǒ bú tài xǐhuan kāfēi.
example.english: Actually, I don't really like coffee.

example.simplified: 麻烦你帮我看一下这个。
example.pinyin: Máfan nǐ bāng wǒ kàn yíxià zhège.
example.english: Could I trouble you to take a look at this?

example.simplified: 我还没习惯这里的天气。
example.pinyin: Wǒ hái méi xíguàn zhèlǐ de tiānqì.
example.english: I'm not used to the weather here yet.
What are you planning to do this weekend?

example.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng zhídé kàn liǎng biàn.
example.english: This movie is worth watching twice.

example.simplified: 用这个工具效率高多了。
example.pinyin: Yòng zhège gōngjù xiàolǜ gāo duō le.
example.english: Using this tool is way more efficient.

example.simplified: 我有点后悔昨天说的话。
example.pinyin: Wǒ yǒudiǎn hòuhuǐ zuótiān shuō de huà.
example.english: I kind of regret what I said yesterday.

example.simplified: 我对这个城市还不太熟悉。
example.pinyin: Wǒ duì zhège chéngshì hái bú tài shúxī.
example.english: I'm not very familiar with this city yet.

entries.english: smooth; going well; without a hitch
